candidates.title: FSD v15.0.1 build 2026.38.6.11 reaches the first AI4 cars, still supervised
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Early US Model Y AI4 cars got Reality View and a Tesla-claimed 25x safety-critical gain; wide release is still December and HW3 is not on this build

candidates.title: Musk says cars remain on AI4 and AI5 goes to Optimus
candidates.whyItMightMatter: No timeline for staying on AI4, no HW3 retrofit date, and no v15 Lite; he calls AI4 enough for superhuman driving and puts AI5 at about 12x

candidates.title: Supply report says AI5 car volume may wait until 2028 as AI4.5 RAM is cut to 24GB
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Commercial Times, citing unnamed supply-chain sources, says GUC's 2027 TSMC 3nm goes to Google and Microsoft first; Musk separately cut planned AI4.5 memory from 32GB to 24GB

candidates.title: EU motor-vehicle committee meeting slips from December 1 to December 15
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Commission confirmed the new TCMV date to Reuters; the file has been discussed twice without a vote, and an EU rejection could unwind the 12 national approvals

candidates.title: Texas roster lists 1,107 Cybercabs after 285 additions, still not a rider count
candidates.whyItMightMatter: DMV list is 1,841 Tesla Robotaxi vehicles, 1,107 Cybercabs and 734 Model Ys; registration under the operator is not cars in service

candidates.title: Dallas Robotaxi map grows north and Tesla says fares are lower, with no numbers
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Official account posted a wider map toward Richardson and said more cars and lower prices, but did not state miles, vehicle counts, or the new fare

candidates.title: Germany lists Tesla's EMAG asset bid for robot gear machines
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Bundeskartellamt case B5-132/26, filed Nov 23 and noticed Nov 27, is a review of an asset purchase, not a closed deal, price, or Optimus output figure

candidates.title: Austin Optimus site shows poured press pads and a steel frame an observer calls 60% done
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Concrete is in the four foundations that were rebar on Nov 20; no presses are installed, and the March 2027 steel estimate is Joe Tegtmeyer's, not Tesla's

candidates.title: Japan Cybercab trademark covers peer-to-peer rentals; no service is announced
candidates.whyItMightMatter: JPO mark 7101386 was granted Nov 13 and reported this week; it runs to 2036 and includes vehicle rentals, but Tesla has not launched Cybercab in Japan

candidates.title: U.S. promo APR on five Model 3 and Model Y trims rises to 2.99% from 2.49%
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Second promo-rate increase in about a month; sticker prices are unchanged and Performance rates did not move with the other trims
